    Read the map carefully

    What this measure can and cannot tell you

    These are county values for residents. They are not your personal cancer risk.

    Method and limitations

    People move. Cancers can develop over many years. Screening, the ages and backgrounds of residents, healthcare access and exposures can affect the values. Values adjusted for age help compare counties. They do not remove all differences. This map does not prove that living in a county causes cancer. It also does not prove that moving would change a person's risk.

    Data sources: where every value comes from

    Every measure comes from a public source. Open the links to check the values yourself.

    Privacy: this site does not ask for or store personal information. Saved priorities stay in your own browser. The web host counts visits and page views. The AI connector counts requests for data the atlas does not have, by word and day only.

    Support: this site is free, with no ads. Donations pay for hosting and data updates. You can give on Ko-fi, one time or monthly.
